name: Orb · SHDR-17
description: A grainy, many-coloured storm raging on the ball: two-level domain-warped fbm on a stereographic wrap of a rotating dome, jovian band shear flowing latitude rings past each other, a four-stop palette with an iridescent cosine rainbow multiplied over it, hashed lightning strikes that strobe while the agent speaks, and two taps of animated white noise — one dithering the gradient into speckle, one as plain film grain (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-17 (MIT).
